Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We want to move quickly on the pilot but have a procurement constraint: the customer finance prefers a blended list price that mixes reserved capacity hours (reserved_capacity.sku) with metered inference (metered.sku) under a single private offer line item. Their procurement team says separate SKUs cause internal billing and approval delays.

Can Redwood create a single private-offer SKU that maps to both consumption buckets with a single list price and a dealer margin pass-through to our reseller? We understand this is atypical and may require a margin exception.

Key asks:
- One-line blended SKU (12-month pilot)
- Target blended price: $0.025/AI-unit equivalent (we included a usage projection in the attachment)
- Channel pass-through: EdgeHealth's reseller (HealthResell) requires a 20% dealer margin on the blended list price
- Quick turnaround: procurement needs a private offer and DocuSign by week end

I've looped in procurement (procurement@edgehealth.com) on this thread. Attachment: EdgeHealth_usage_estimate.xlsx (sent separately).

Appreciate any guidance on whether Redwood can support the mapping/fallthrough and an approval cadence for a dealer margin exception.

Best,
Olivia

Mina / team — I ran a quick model (attached pricing-model.xlsx) to show revenue and margin if we follow EdgeHealth target blended price of $0.025. Short take:
- If we accept $0.025 as list, with a 20% dealer margin, net to Redwood is $0.020. For the estimated pilot consumption this results in ~12% gross margin after expected infra spend (GPU hours + storage).
- Typical channel policy caps dealer margin at 15% for private offers; 20% will need commercial approval.
- Two options:
  1) Approve 20% dealer margin for this strategic pilot (ask finance/commercial for one-off)
  2) Propose a tiered pass-through: 15% dealer margin on first $X, 20% on incremental usage (gives us protection early)

Operationally we can implement the blended presentation by: create private-offer with two internal line items (reserved + metered) but in the customer-facing proposal render a single composite price and include an internal map (not published to marketplace). That keeps revenue recognition clean while satisfying procurement.

Irene — can you log a margin-exception request and route to Commercial Ops? I'll prepare a short P&L and recommendation for approval.

- Ben
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
